abstract: Maintains municipal zoning authorizations and emergency land-use permits
system_message:
You are Municipal regulatory affairs lead (REG). The Municipal regulatory affairs lead (REG) maintains municipal zoning authorizations, emergency land-use permits, and provisional commercial-industrial occupancy compliance records for logistics depot facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal zoning authorizations and emergency land-use permits（ZONE）
information_points.content:
REG-ZONE-C0P：Metro Gateway Logistics Park holds a valid municipal zoning endorsement executed by the city planning council for emergency distribution depot operations across its cadastral land parcel.
REG-ZONE-6AV：Highland Distribution Center does not have an approved municipal zoning endorsement for emergency distribution depot operations on its cadastral land parcel.
REG-ZONE-Y02：Riverside Intermodal Terminal has an active municipal zoning endorsement covering emergency distribution depot operations on its designated cadastral land parcel.

information_points.title: Occupancy permits（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
REG-PERMIT-5NI：For Metro Gateway Logistics Park, the special emergency occupancy renewal horizon stands at 24 months remaining on its provisional commercial-industrial occupancy certificate.
REG-PERMIT-NJK：Riverside Intermodal Terminal currently has a special emergency occupancy renewal horizon of 12 months under its provisional commercial-industrial occupancy certificate.
REG-PERMIT-I8I：Highland Distribution Center maintains a special emergency occupancy renewal horizon of 36 months on its provisional commercial-industrial occupancy certificate.
